details.report: Implemented and committed the Issue #17 construction/bundle vertical in four forward commits (df5c59a..79e5956). Replaced axis-compartment proposals with one common material population and nonbinding overlapping relevance hints; introduced distinct canonical-Skill and package recipe identities; compiled a deterministic immutable path+digest bundle; carried that bundle across the sole accepted execution seam; atomically materialized and read-back verified every clone before any provider starts; retained materialization evidence; and preserved exact task/target/capability/scope-key and existing settlement/output behavior. Superseded transcription/compartment tests were migrated once and focused confinement, symlink, collision, digest, common-access, dual-identity, cardinality, determinism, no-start, package and settlement regressions pass. Validation: typecheck passed; focused 25-test construction/agent/ledger battery passed; cold-installed package lifecycle passed; npm pack --dry-run and git diff --check passed. Isolated-HOME full run reached 309 pass, 5 skip; its two remaining failures are the pre-existing, separately classified Issue #31 Judge contract compatibility tests (tests 160/163), outside this four-class authority. Three transient package failures in that run were caused by the then-untracked new files and were subsequently closed by committing them and rerunning the cold-install lifecycle. Working tree is clean.
